goal: Estimate six 3-D optical skin landmark displacements on the stored walking clock. Millimetres, original laboratory axes, Z up.
source: Schreiber & Moissenet, Scientific Data 6, 111 (2019), 10.1038/s41597-019-0124-4. Moissenet & Schreiber, Figshare v8, 10.6084/m9.figshare.7734767.v8. Three lowest numeric repeats of condition C2 per sorted participant. Ordinals 1-30 fit, 31-40 assess (previously studied for other outcomes), 41-50 unopened. Reuse original bytes and supplementary channel availability; ignore foot/plate quality. No one-person training updates during assessment.
anchors: Zero-based frame 39, 44, 49,... while t+20 < N. Include each time and each target landmark having finite XYZ and nonnegative finite C3D residual at both t and t+20. Missing target on one landmark cannot exclude any other. No outcome-value or phase-based exclusions. No stride boundary, force plate or foot contact required.
input: 40 consecutive 100 Hz point frames, shape (40,8,3). Order L_FAL,R_FAL,L_FLE,R_FLE,L_RSP,R_RSP,L_IAS,R_IAS. Coordinates in lab XYZ mm, missing nonfinite or negative/nonfinite point residual. Eight tokens, one per 5 point frames. For each token: eight (last marker position minus midpoint of last left/right anterior pelvis), eight (last minus first position), 8 validity bits for positions and 8 for movement. Missing floats standardized to the training mean (normalized zero). EMG adds RMS in microvolts and finite bits for eight right-leg channels. For token ending f, use 60 analog samples ending at the center of f's 15-sample block inclusive: [15*f-52,15*f+8). Thus eight tokens spaced 50 ms, each EMG RMS covers the trailing 40 ms. Missing channel per source Supplementary Table 2 or any nonfinite sample maps to missing.
output: Six vectors ordered L_FAL,R_FAL,L_FLE,R_FLE,L_RSP,R_RSP, each stored xyz[t+20]-xyz[t] in mm.
models: Ridge markers and ridge combined standardized flattened tokens; train per coordinate with missing targets masked, ridge penalty 0.01 times total observation weight and unpenalized intercept. One residual temporal Transformer for each ridge: width 32, 4 attention heads, learned position, one pre-layernorm block with attention and 64-wide ReLU feedforward, learned last-token head, no dropout. Train normalized displacement residuals using masked MSE, AdamW lr 0.002, decay 0.001, batch 128, 24 epochs, seed 20261121, final epoch, no assessment selection. During training, weight people equally, then trials equally, then cutoffs equally. Baseline analytic numeric regression and normalization float64, torch float32. Fit two alternative CPU thread routes on fixed preliminary mini-batches without refitting on assessment.
controls: Persistence zero. Velocity extrapolates t minus t-4 times 5, uses persistence only for missing velocity. Phase template: latest preceding or simultaneous source-annotated left/right strike/off plus elapsed time rounded down to 5-frame bins; train-only average displacement per bin (person/trial balanced weighted windows), fallback same event then global. Annotation-assisted offline comparator, no future event. Wrong EMG: evaluate each later repeat using previous selected repeat from SAME person, replacing whole eight-token muscle histories at nearest elapsed frame since crop start, earlier donor only, ties earliest. Personal template: on second and third repeats only, match final 2 tokens of standardized marker history to 3 nearest anchor histories in the immediately preceding completed repeat for that same person, inverse-distance weights 1/(0.01+RMS distance). Use its observed displacement for each valid landmark; no different person, future repeat, target of scored repeat or target-conditioned nearest selection. On this paired subset also show the matching normal models.
metrics: For each walker and landmark, average 3D Euclidean error (mm) across all available cutoffs of that walker (pooled repeats). For each walker average its landmark means equally; then average across people. Report by walker, landmark, and model, counts of people/trials/cutoffs and landmark targets. Report distribution of actual displacement magnitudes. Report mean and 95% percentile interval from 10000 paired walker-cluster bootstrap resamples with replacement, seed 20261121, per model and paired contrast. Report paired people improved. Ten-walker intervals describe this partition; no multiplicity-adjusted population claims.
criteria: Prespecified claim of incremental EMG requires combined Transformer lower error than marker Transformer on all scored anchors AND lower than wrong-repeat combined Transformer on eligible later-repeat anchors. For each comparison require paired mean difference <0, bootstrap upper 95% endpoint <0, and at least 70% of available walkers improved. Transformer advantage requires combined Transformer pass same rule against both matched linear models, persistence, velocity, and phase template on all anchors, and personal template on jointly valid later-repeat targets. Report every result even on failure.
scope: Stored author gap-filled, bidirectionally 6 Hz filtered marker coordinates; right-leg surface EMG trial-centered and bidirectionally bandpassed 30–300 Hz, then trailing RMS here. Authors used event-cropped trials. No direct neural signal or real-time lead established. Four limbs observed via three bilateral pairs of surface landmarks; wrists contribute arm markers only. No joint centers, joint angles, forces, contact labels as model inputs, sensation, other tasks or devices.
